steps.description: Pre-filter to genes with >=10 counts in >=5 samples (the smallest group size). Build DESeqDataSet with design ~subject+condition (subject as blocking factor, condition releveled so 'control' is the reference). plan.title: Paired subject DESeq2 control vs treated DE + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: Five subjects each contribute one control and one treated blood sample (n=10, paired), raw STAR/featureCounts integer counts over 12000 genes. The research question — which genes respond to treatment within each subject — is answered by a within-subject (paired) differential expression test: DESeq2 with design ~subject + condition removes each subject's baseline expression level before testing the condition effect, so the comparison is made within each subject rather than across unrelated individuals. Track 1 runs sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap colored by subject and condition) to confirm the paired structure and rule out an outlier sample before the design is trusted, then the DESeq2 Wald test on ~subject+condition with a minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=5 samples, the smallest group size), apeglm shrinkage of the condition coefficient, and BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha=0.05. Track 2 takes the full ranked gene list (Wald statistic, as sourced) into fgsea preranked GSEA against the MSigDB Hallmark collection (50 sets, human, 2026.1, staged locally) with a Reactome follow-up pass (staged locally), reporting collapsed/leading-edge sets. A final report step consolidates DE tables (unshrunken and shrunken log2FC), fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), the p-value histogram diagnostic, enrichment results with database/version/rank-metric/universe stated, and a full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, gene set collection versions, seeds).

steps.method: min 10 counts in >= smallest group size (5)
design = ~subject + condition, explicit reference level control
apeglm shrinkage of the condition coefficient
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
Consolidated DE + enrichment report with diagnostics and reproducibility record
